title: Amp diagnostic protection mode
shortDescription: Onkyo AVR entered AMP DIAG protection due to amp/short fault.
fullDescription:
Onkyo TX-NR series and TX-RZ series display AMP DIAG when the amp section detects a fault. On older models (2011-2014 era) this was famously linked to a defective HDMI board solder joint; newer units still trigger on speaker shorts.

First rule out speaker wiring before assuming internal failure.

fixSteps.title: Power on empty
fixSteps.instruction: If still AMP DIAG, internal fault.

fixSteps.title: Reflow HDMI board if legacy
fixSteps.instruction: Older TX-NR models: reflow HDMI daughter-board solder (professional).

whenToCallPro: Still fails with no speakers - service or HDMI reflow.

faq.q: Is the HDMI bug still an issue?
faq.a: Only on 2010-2014 TX-NR models; newer units use reliable HDMI chipsets.

title: Thermal shutdown
fullDescription: Onkyo units run hot - especially TX-RZ flagship models with 9+ channels. Poor ventilation quickly triggers shutdown.
symptoms: Shuts off after prolonged loud use

title: HDMI handshake failure
shortDescription: Black screen or flickering due to HDCP/handshake negotiation.
fullDescription: Onkyo historically had HDMI board issues on TX-NR series. Newer TX-RZ models with 8K support have their own 2.1 handshake bugs addressed by firmware.
whenToCallPro: Classic HDMI board failure on older units.

title: AccuEQ room calibration failed
shortDescription: Onkyo's room correction aborted during measurement.
fullDescription: AccuEQ (and Dirac Live on newer models) fails on mic issues, wrong polarity, or environmental noise. Similar to Denon Audyssey.

faq.a: TX-RZ50/RZ70 ship with Dirac Live Room Correction.

title: Firmware update failed
shortDescription: Update interrupted; unit may appear bricked.
fullDescription: Network drop or power loss during an Onkyo firmware update can leave unit in update loop. Try USB recovery if available.

fixSteps.title: USB recovery
fixSteps.instruction: Download firmware to USB and retry on newer models.

videoSearchQuery: Onkyo firmware update failed USB recovery

title: Video plays but no audio
fullDescription: Muted, source bitstream issue, or eARC negotiation fault.

faq.a: Ensure AMP not TV is selected for audio routing.

title: Unit shutting down on its own
fullDescription: Onkyo Sleep timer can be set to auto shutoff after X minutes. Commonly set accidentally from remote.

faq.q: Why does EU require auto standby?
faq.a: EU energy regs mandate default auto-off after inactivity.

title: Zone 2 silent
fullDescription: Like other brands, Zone 2 on Onkyo only accepts analog or stereo PCM. HDMI bitstream not supported.

title: Check speaker wire
shortDescription: Amp detected a speaker short on power-up.
fullDescription: Onkyo's amp self-check catches stray wire strands and low-impedance loads.

title: Streaming network offline
shortDescription: Onkyo Controller app cannot find device.
fullDescription: Network streaming features fail when the AVR cannot reach Onkyo servers. Could be local WiFi, router firewall, or Onkyo cloud outage.

faq.a: Yes on most Onkyo models with Chromecast built-in.
